en.topic_title: Hong Kong considers heavier fines for pet abandonment following fatal Yuen Long dog attack
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong authorities are considering heavier fines for pet abandonment, the environment minister has said as an operation to capture stray dogs after a fatal dog attack in Yuen Long continued.



Dogs in Yuen Long on September 22, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said during a Legislative Council meeting on Wednesday that dog owners bear responsibility for their pets, and that there should be consequences if they give them up.
